_note: Checked-in routing corpus for code-decomposer. CAVEAT: routing-eval measures LEXICAL TOKEN OVERLAP ONLY — it is a legibility aid, not a verdict. The indirect/paraphrase positives (the last 2–3) are deliberately low-overlap to test recall; a lexical miss on them is a PROXY artifact (B4-blindness), NOT a description defect. The negatives are ADVERSARIAL: each is a real trigger for a NAMED confusable sibling. Every *-decomposer here shares the 'decompose / design / grade on two crossing axes' vocabulary, so the family collides on surface tokens by construction. The sharpest collision is component-decomposer (which also says 'design this', 'grade this', 'is it production-ready') — it owns a ZERO-DEP WEB COMPONENT (Custom Element, geometry, FACE), where this skill owns a UNIT OF CODE (function/module/change, SPEC×EXECUTION, tests, the toolchain). query/type/regex-decomposer own SQL/schemas/patterns; the slash-command peers (/code-review, /verify, /simplify) and arch-system own diff-time bug hunting, running the app, quality cleanup, and architecture — all explicitly fenced. The negatives surface exactly these collisions; re-derive when the neighbourhood changes.
